evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list names it the Defence Industries Organization Training and Research Institute, also known as the Defence Ministry’s Institute for Defence Education and Research, in Tehran.
It belongs to Iran’s defence ministry, as its name on Canada’s list says.
